name: SikaTile-405 Lite
paste:
SIKATILE®-405 LITE: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaTile®-405 Lite, September 2023, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikatile-405-lite.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaTile®-405 Lite where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaTile®-405 Lite is a flexible, premium, sand and Silica free, tile and stone adhesive with Lightweight Glass Technology for a smooth, easy to trowel application.
    - SikaTile®-405 Lite superior non-sag and slip resistance for large heavy tiles and non-slump properties to eliminate tile lipage.
    - SikaTile®-405 Lite is ideal for internal and external, for wall and floor applications.
    - SikaTile®-405 Liteis white in colour making it suitable for fixing white and translucent natural stone.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaTile®-405 Lite is suitable for both thin-bed and thick-bed tile and stone applications up to; 10mm layer thickness.
    - Suitable for residential & commercial applications
    - Thin and thick-bed tiling applications up to 10mm thick
    - Wall & floor applications
    - Internal and external applications
    - Sika approved under-tile waterproofing systems
    - Under-tile heating systems
    - Sika approved acoustic reduction underlayment's
    - Concrete
    - Compressed cement boards*
    - Cement-based screeds and renders
    - Ceramic tile underlay / Fibre cement sheeting*
    - Existing ceramic tiles (primed with SikaTile 015 NPP)
    - Autoclaved aerated concrete / AAC
    - Other suitable construction boards designed to receive tile & stone.
    - Ceramic & Porcelain tiles
    - Natural stone (not sensitive to moisture)
    - Agglomerates / Terrazzo / Man made stone (not sensitive to moisture)
    - Mosaic tiles
    - Quarry & Vitrified tiles
    Suitable substrates include;
    *refer to board manufacturer strict installation instructions for further details and load limits
    Suitable tile types include;
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.9.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaTile®-405 Lite
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A FLEXIBLE, PREMIUM, SAND AND SILICA FREE, TILE AND STONE ADHESIVE WITH LIGHTWEIGHT GLASS TECHNOLOGY FOR A SMOOTH, EASY TO TROWEL APPLICATION
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (September 2023, Version 01.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS ISO 13007: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; cited with a stated property or value. Where: Features (p.1); Product Information > Product declaration (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Lightweight Glass Technology made from 100% recycled glass.
    - Excellent coverage, The coverage of a 13.5kg bag of SikaTile®-405 Lite is equivalent to a traditional 25kg bag of sanded adhesive, due to the Lightweight Glass Technology
    - Crystalline Silica free formulation
    - Sand free formulation
    - AS ISO 13007 - C2TES1 classification
    - Smooth easy trowel application
    - Excellent non slump performance
    - Versatile, internal & external applications
    - White in colour making it suitable for light and translucent natural stone
    - Low VOC
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Product declaration: C2TES1 as per AS ISO 13007
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 13.5kg paper bags
    - Shelf life: if unopened 12 months from date of manufacture
    - Storage conditions: Store in dry cool conditions, off ground out of direct sunlight. High humidity will reduce shelf life.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality.
    - All substrates must minimum deflection requirement outlined in the Australia standards.
    - Substrates must be properly cured, structurally sound, free from loose or friable particles, clean, dry and free from contaminates such as dust, dirt, oil, grease, curing compounds, laitance or efflorescence.
    - Dependant on the substrate condition and contamination to be removed from the surface, perform adequate preparation techniques such as water blasting, scarification, or blast cleaning in order to remove all traces of any materials that could reduce the products adhesion to the substrate.
    - Any small defects in surface variations in level, profile or around exposed aggregates for example, Surface correction use appropriate Sika MonoTop® repair mortar or Sikafloor® level range should be used. Cracks in substrates must be identified and sealed / treated appropriately. For areas that require a waterproofing membrane, a suitable Sika approved under-tile waterproof membrane should be used prior to tiling.
3.3 Substrate quality - Concrete substrates.
    - Concrete shall be dry and adequately cured. Concrete shall be left with open surface - steel trowel finishes are generally acceptable if they accept water penetration.
    - All traces of curing compounds, sealers, release agents, coatings, dust, dirt, oil, and any other contaminate that may inhibit the adhesion must be removed prior to tiling. Concrete must accept water and be free from Laitence.
3.4 Substrate quality - Cement Mortar Beds / Screeds.
    - Screeds shall be installed in accordance with Australian Standards.
    - Early aged screeds shall be a minimum of 24 hours old per 40mm of thickness (at 22°C & 50% relative humidity).
3.5 Substrate quality - Sheeted / Board substrates.
    - All boards / sheets / underlays must be installed asper manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling.
3.6 Substrate preparation - Substrate priming.
    - Substrates that have a under-tile waterproofing membrane do not require a primer. Adhesive shall be applied direct to the waterproofing membrane.
    - Other Sika branded porous primers designed for tiling applications may be used to prime substrates.
    - Refer to specific primer details on the relevant product datasheet.
    | Application | Primer |
    | Porous substrates | SikaTile 010 Secure Prime |
    | Non porous substrates | SikaTile 015 NPP |

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 6 - 7 Litres of water per 13.5 kg bag
    - Pot Life: 2.5 hours at 23°C and 50% relative humidity.
    - Open Time: 30 minutes at 23°C and 50% relative humidity.
4.3 Consumption.
    | Notched trowel size | Approximate coverage per bag |
    | 6mm | 11m2 |
    | 10mm | 6.5m2 |
    | Coverage shall be used as a guide only due to surface profile and application technique. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.4 Applied product ready for use.
    | Application | Approximate wait time |
    | Grouting / Light foot traffic | 24 hours |
    | Wet area service | 3 days |
    | Full service | 3-5 days |
    | Site condition will impact wait times. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Values determined at laboratory conditions: 23°C, & 50% RH. Higher temperatures will reduce wait times and lower temperatures will increase wait times.
4.5 Equipment.
    - Personal protective equipment
    - mixing drill with stirring attachment
    - Mixing buckets
4.6 Mixing.
    - Pour cool fresh water into a clean mixing container before slowly adding the adhesive powder.
    - Mix with a mixing drill for approximately 2-3minutes to achieve a smooth lump free homogenous lump free mixture
    - Allow the mixture to Stand for 5-10 minutes, then restir for an additional 2 minutes without adding any additional water.
    - Restirring the mixture may be necessary during the adhesives pot-life.
4.7 Application.
    - Tiles shall be fixed in accordance with the relevant Australian standards.
    - Ensure the backs of the tiles are clean and free from dust and contaminates.
    - Apply the adhesive to the substrate with the appropriately sized trowel to achieve coverage requirement on both substrate and the back of the tile. Tiles may require "back-buttering" to achieve minimum coverage requirements.
    - Apply the adhesive with the notched trowel in a single direction.
    - Place the tile into the wet adhesive, break the ridges with the tile to fully bed the tile into the adhesive. It is advisable to periodically check the back of the tiles to ensure adequate adhesive coverage is achieved in accordance with Australian Standards.
    - Only apply as much adhesive that can be covered by the tiles prior the adhesive skinning. If skinning occurs prior to placement of tiles remove and replace.
    - Remove any excess adhesive from the face of the tiles with a damp sponge and ensure grout joints are clean and free from excess adhesive and uniform depth.
4.8 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water while the adhesive is still wet.
4.9 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Application shall be undertaken in according with Australian Standards
    - SikaTile®-405 Lite is not suitable for use with moisture sensitive stone.
    - SikaTile®-405 Lite is not suitable for direct use over timber substrates, over sheet with a suitable underlay or screed.
    - Mechanical fixing methods are recommended when used externally about 2.7 meters.
    - Efflorescence is beyond the control of the manufacturer due to external influences beyond our control.
    - SikaTile®-405 Lite is not suitable for direct application over solvent based coatings and membranes.
    - Contact Sika Australia for further information or applications not mentioned in the document.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.9):
    - SikaTile®-405 Lite is not suitable for use with moisture sensitive stone.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaTile®-405 Lite, September 2023, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikatile-405-lite.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaTile®-405 Lite, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sds-sikatile-405lite.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
